title: Open Values Avoid Token Index v0.1
description: For each company a person can choose to avoid, the lowercase names of the company and the brands it owns, for matching against text on other web pages. The data build writes it for a planned browser extension and other tools.

format.description: Names this file's format, so a reader can check it before reading the rest of the file.

version.description: The version of the format this file follows, such as "0.1".

built.description: The date of the source data this file was built from, as YYYY-MM-DD.

source.description: The files the token lists were built from, as paths in the repository.

purpose.description: One sentence on what this file is for and how its tokens are made.

matching.description: How a tool should compare page text with the tokens.

families.description: One family per avoid line. An avoid line, from content/lines.json, lets a person hide a company and the brands it owns.

stats.description: Counts of families, tokens, unique tokens, and the file's size in bytes.

normalization.description: How to change text before comparing it, such as lowercasing and removing accents and punctuation.

boundary.description: Where a match may start and end, such as at word boundaries.

appLaneNote.description: A note on which choices this file leaves to the tool that reads it.

id.description: The id of the avoid line, such as "avoid:amazon".

line.description: The node id of the avoid line, such as "ovs:line/avoid:amazon".

label.description: The company's name as shown to readers.

entity.description: The company's name as a single lowercase token, such as "amazon".

tokens.description: The lowercase plain-letter names to match: the company, its brands from the line and the ownership map, and its aliases. No name appears twice.

tokenCount.description: How many tokens the family has.

source.description: The files the family was built from.

sourceLineBrands.description: How many brand names the line lists in content/lines.json.

sourceCompanyBrands.description: How many brand names the ownership map links to the company in companies.json.
